title: Number of Islands
prompt: Given an `m x n` 2D grid of `'1'`s (land) and `'0'`s (water), return the number of islands — a connected group of land cells connected horizontally or vertically (analogous to counting connected components in a cluster/node topology).
hints: Scan every cell; when you find unvisited land, that's a new island — flood-fill from there to mark the whole connected region visited.
BFS or DFS both work for the flood fill; either explore in-place by mutating the grid or track a separate visited set.
The answer is just the count of times you started a new flood fill from unvisited land.
